title: ROI Calculator
description: Enter what you expect to invest and gain to see your return on investment, net return, and payback period update as you type.

elements.name: initialInvestment
elements.title: One-time initial investment (USD)
elements.description: Setup, implementation, equipment, training, or launch costs.

elements.name: ongoingMonthlyCost
elements.title: Ongoing monthly cost (USD)
elements.description: Subscription fees, ad spend, staff time, or maintenance. Enter 0 if none.

elements.name: timePeriodMonths
elements.title: Time period
elements.description: How long you want to measure the return over.

elements.name: additionalMonthlyRevenue
elements.title: Additional monthly revenue (USD)
elements.description: New sales or income you expect each month as a result of the investment.

elements.name: monthlyCostSavings
elements.title: Monthly cost savings (USD)
elements.description: Time saved, lower vendor costs, fewer errors. Enter 0 if none.

elements.name: roiResults
elements.title: Your results
elements.visibleIf: {initialInvestment} notempty and {ongoingMonthlyCost} notempty and {timePeriodMonths} notempty and {additionalMonthlyRevenue} notempty and {monthlyCostSavings} notempty

elements.name: totalInvestment
elements.title: Total investment
elements.description: Initial investment plus ongoing costs over the period.

elements.name: totalGain
elements.title: Total gain
elements.description: Additional revenue plus cost savings over the period.

elements.name: roiPercent
elements.title: Return on investment (ROI)
elements.description: Net return divided by total investment.

elements.name: monthlyNetGain
elements.title: Net gain per month
elements.description: Monthly revenue and savings minus the ongoing monthly cost.

elements.name: paybackMonths
elements.title: Payback period
elements.description: Months until the net gains cover the initial investment.

elements.name: noPaybackNote
elements.html: No payback within this scenario. The ongoing monthly cost is equal to or higher than the monthly revenue and savings, so the initial investment is never recovered. Try a lower ongoing cost or higher expected gains.

elements.name: paybackBeyondPeriodNote
elements.html: Payback takes longer than the selected period. The investment pays for itself after the period you chose, so the ROI above is negative. Choose a longer time period to see the full picture.

elements.name: roiDisclaimer
elements.html: These figures are estimates based on the numbers you entered. They do not account for taxes, inflation, financing costs, or changes in your business over time.

elements.name: wantsReport
elements.title: Would you like a detailed ROI report by email?
elements.description: We'll send a PDF with your numbers and a month-by-month breakdown.
